title.zh: v2.1.0 手机端：曲风制作器、挑战与大师课都按得到了；顺手修掉一个会空转的检查
title.en: v2.1.0 On a Phone: The Genre Maker, Challenge and Masterclass Are Hittable Too

highlights.zh: **三个视图 8 + 5 + 1 → 0**：**maker** 的 fork 下拉只有 140×**18**、Fork 43×24、`New Blank Genre`/`Saved`/`Poster & Share`/`Workshop Guide`/`Open in Studio` 一排 34 px，还有元数据表单里 316×38 的名称输入；**challenge** 的证书按钮 34 px、重置 32×32、三档难度 32–34 px；**masterclass** 的 Guide 128×30。同一形状的表单控件（名称/分类/作者/BPM/音阶/拍号）一并按 44 px 处理——它们只是再往下滚一屏的同一种东西，不修就是「量不到就不算」的自欺。
highlights.en: **Three views went 8 + 5 + 1 → 0**: the **maker**'s fork select was 140×**18**, Fork 43×24, and the `New Blank Genre` / `Saved` / `Poster & Share` / `Workshop Guide` / `Open in Studio` row 34 px tall, plus a 316×38 name field in the metadata form; **challenge**'s certificate button was 34 px, reset 32×32 and the three difficulty buttons 32–34 px; **masterclass**'s guide was 128×30. The identically shaped form controls (name, category, author, BPM, scale, meter) were done in…

highlights.zh: 四个文件都从 `useDeviceCapabilities()` 读 `isMobile`，**桌面路径一行未改**。量后：maker 15 控件 / 0 低于 44，challenge 12 / 0，masterclass 10 / 0，横屏同样 0；E2E 手机门禁现在覆盖 **7 个面**。
highlights.en: All four files read `isMobile` from `useDeviceCapabilities()` and **the desktop path is untouched**. After: maker 15 controls / 0 under 44, challenge 12 / 0, masterclass 10 / 0, and 0 in landscape; the E2E phone gate now covers **seven surfaces**.

highlights.zh: **顺手修掉一个「构造上就会空转」的检查**：加完 7 面门禁后，iPhone 两个方向都报 `genre switch 1: navigations=0 patternFlips=0`。加了诊断一量才发现：那个 chip **本来就是当前曲风**——检查固定点 `chipSelectors[1]` 并假定它一定是别的曲风，而 App 把当前曲风存在 state 里，前面几步（这一轮新加的门禁会走一遍 maker）已经切到过它，于是点击是**合法的 no-op**。现在从排除当前曲风后的头三个 chip 里逐个试，只要有一个真的换了曲风就通过；真坏掉的处理器仍然会失败。
highlights.en: **A check that was vacuous by construction got fixed along the way**: after the seven-surface gate landed, both iPhone orientations reported `genre switch 1: navigations=0 patternFlips=0`.
